text:
Alex P: Taking Monday off — want something to binge. Prefer short stuff (2–10 eps) or a couple of movies. No heavy sci‑fi, mood: cozy but weird. Any recs? :coffee:
Maria G: If you want cozy+weird: watch 'Russian Doll' (2 seasons, weird in the best way). laughs + tiny spoilers. :grin:
Jamal R: For movies, try the Before trilogy. Slow, gorgeous, very bingeable in an evening. 
Sasha L: Or a single weird cozy movie: 'The Grand Budapest Hotel' — gorgeous sets, fast jokes. :hotel:
Alex P: Ooh Grand Budapest — hadn't thought of that. Any book recs in the same vibe? Looking for something shortish to read on the plane.
Maria G: Bookwise, 'The Secret History' is moody but a bit long. For short: try 'Eileen' — dark, compact.
Jamal R: If you want something utterly charming and tiny, 'The Uncommon Reader' (like 100 pages). Felt like a warm blanket.
Sasha L: Also 'The Night Watch' by Sarah Waters if you're into atmospheric historical fiction.
Alex P: Nice — thanks. Are any of these good for a one-sitting watch/read?
Maria G: Grand Budapest = one sitting. Uncommon Reader = one-ish sitting. Russian Doll needs pacing (you'll want breaks).
Jamal R: I can host a mini watch party Sunday night if people want to join for Grand Budapest. 8pm PT? :popcorn:
Sasha L: I can make snacks. :raised_hands: Count me in.
Librarian Bot: New recommendation added to #book-shelf: 'The Uncommon Reader' — tag: short-reads, cozy. https://books.example/uncommon-reader
Alex P: Love it. Poll: movie night (Grand Budapest) vs two short films (100–120 mins total). React with :one: for movie night, :two: for short films.
Maria G: :one:
Jamal R: :one:
Sasha L: :two: (got snacks either way)
Alex P: Looks like movie night wins. Saving the watch-party deets to calendar and DMing link. Thanks all — recs were perfect. :sparkles:
